title: K1734 rev4: remediate H2 scope/gate mismatch + fig4 QLIKE p-value, then re-certify

claude_followup.brief: K1734 rev4 collection: read experiments/k1734/k1734_h2_gate_fix_report.json (route choice + BH recomputation) and experiments/k1734/review_verdict.json (rev4 verdict, sha-pinned). Verify: (1) the H2 route decision is justified and the added test is same-caliber, (2) the BH family recomputation is honest about its effect on H3_oos_cw_mse (was BH-adj p=0.0451, a thin margin that may not survive a larger family), (3) fig4 no longer attaches an MSE p to a QLIKE plot, (4) untouched numbers reproduced identically. Then run experiment_gates.py certify. On a genuine rev4 PASS: merge via scripts/merge_worktree.sh and write the knowledge entry (main-thread writes knowledge, never the agent - K1259). On rev4 FAIL: do NOT merge, record the new blocking defects and decide remediate-vs-3-strike-escalate. Codex effort ladder for experiment is at ceiling, so a third failed remediation cycle should escalate to the boss rather than re-run the same review.
